caption: The drawing depicts a textile with a rectangular shape, shown against a plain background. The textile is rendered in shades of blue, with varying intensity to indicate pattern details and texture. It features a complex design composed of various sections: on the left side, there are repeated motifs of stylized birds, architectural structures resembling buildings or churches, and a geometric border. The lower portion includes a row of eagle-like birds with widespread wings, facing forward, set against a darker background. The central and upper right section of the textile is filled with a repeating pattern of abstract floral or fruit-like elements interspersed with symmetrical, curved lines and small star-like shapes. At the bottom edge, the textile has a fringe, also rendered in blue. The drawing includes handwritten text below the textile, which provides information such as "Westchester County," "Scale 24'' to 3 Feet," and "drawn by I. De Savage." The off-white background of the page contrasts with the blue hues of the textile, highlighting its patterns and details.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
